en.title: Rental management
en.summary: Listings, personal check-in, guest support and monthly rental statements.
en.description: From preparing your home to welcoming each guest, we manage the practical work of renting out your property on the Costa Blanca.

rows.title: Preparing your home
rows.text: We guide you through the documentation and tourism rental licence process, then help with the checklist, orders and purchases needed to prepare your home for guests.

rows.title: Photography and listings
rows.text: We photograph your property and its surroundings, prepare the descriptions and publish on selected rental platforms. We manage their booking and payment processes.

rows.title: A rental plan for your property
rows.text: We agree a strategy around your plans, the location, facilities and seasonal demand. Pricing and occupancy are considered together, alongside the care of your home.

rows.title: Welcoming and supporting guests
rows.text: Our Guest Experience Team is personally present at every check-in and provides 24/7 support. We handle guest registration, security deposits and communication, and provide digital guides to the home and local area.

rows.title: Cleaning and property care
rows.text: La Lavandería Alicante handles cleaning and linen after guest and owner departures. The cleaning team checks for wear and tear, while we coordinate maintenance and repairs through our property management service.

en.seoTitle: Rental management on Costa Blanca | Nordic RentAway
en.seoDescription: Preparation, photography, listing presentation and the day-to-day work around your holiday rental. Talk to Nordic RentAway Spain about your property.
en.questionsHeading: Before you rent out your home
en.questionsIntro: Your calendar, the service and the costs — a few useful details before our first conversation.

questions.question: What does rental management cost?
questions.answer: Our management fee is 25% + VAT, deducted from the monthly payout. You receive an invoice and a rental statement. Individual maintenance costs are handled separately.

questions.question: When do I receive my rental income?
questions.answer: We transfer rental income each month following the guest’s departure, with the management fee deducted. Your statement sets out the rental income and charges.

questions.question: Can I still use my own home?
questions.answer: Yes. We coordinate your personal stays and block those dates on the rental platforms. The Owner’s Portal gives you access to a live calendar of reservations.

questions.question: How is cleaning paid for?
questions.answer: Guests pay a separate cleaning fee when booking. We handle that payment directly with the cleaning company, so it does not appear in your monthly rental statement.
